name: FUN_0051e380
target_state: implemented staging candidate; integrator review pending

observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: The body never writes EAX itself. The callee 0x00453540 does, on every path (the decremented subobject word, or zero on the wrap path), and the bare RET at 0x0051e397 hands that word back unchanged. The reconstruction therefore declares the target with the callee's return width and forwards it. The adjacent slot 0x0051e340 returns its value the same way, which corroborates but does not prove the reading.
observed_original_abi.return_semantics: EAX at the target's exit is the callee's EAX, a 32-bit word, on every path. The target's own instructions never write EAX.
observed_original_abi.stack_frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x10; the receiver is spilled to [EBP-0x10] and reloaded, and the spill slot is never dereferenced
observed_original_abi.adjustor: 0x0051e38c ADD ECX,0x4 -- the callee's receiver is the subobject at receiver+0x4, not the receiver itself

vtable_placement.evidence: Live Ghidra /read_memory over the twelve vptr-backed tables the classifier associates with this target. 0x0051e380 is a slot in each, always adjacent to 0x0051e340 (the pre-increment of the same subobject word). Observed 0-indexed slot pairs (0x0051e340, 0x0051e380): (0,1) at 0x013ef110, 0x013ef1c0, 0x013ef270, 0x013ef320; (1,2) at 0x013f1a30; (4,5) at 0x013ef3c0, 0x013f031c, 0x013ef6a4, 0x013f1c6c; (12,13) at 0x013f21d8; (14,15) at 0x013f2194 and 0x013f2698. The V1-VFT rule fired on a table where the pair sits at 1-indexed slots 15 and 16.
vtable_placement.sibling_slot: 0x0051e340 (the pre-increment of the same subobject word at receiver+0x4)
vtable_placement.not_claimed: No class hierarchy is claimed. SporeApp.exe carries no MSVC RTTI, the tables mix code addresses with non-code words, and this body is reachable only through these slots. Co-membership establishes 'virtual member of some class', never a class name.

mechanics.kind: this-adjusting forwarder: spill the receiver, reload it, add a fixed displacement, make one direct call, return the callee's EAX
mechanics.receiver_spill: 0x0051e386 MOV dword ptr [EBP-0x10],ECX / 0x0051e389 MOV ECX,dword ptr [EBP-0x10] -- the receiver is spilled and reloaded around the adjustor; the spill slot is never dereferenced
mechanics.adjustor: 0x0051e38c ADD ECX,0x4 -- the callee's receiver is the subobject at receiver+0x4
mechanics.transfer: 0x0051e38f CALL 0x00453540 -- the body's only transfer, a direct call with no stack argument pushed
mechanics.epilogue: 0x0051e394 MOV ESP,EBP / 0x0051e396 POP EBP / 0x0051e397 RET -- bare RET, caller cleans, the callee's EAX is what comes back

field_offsets.role: this-pointer adjustor from the receiver to the subobject whose method is called
field_offsets.corroboration: Not corroborated by a machine-derived receiver bounds record: the persisted evidence pack holds no listing for this target, so the receiver record is absent. The displacement is pinned to its instruction by a static_assert in the header and is a this-pointer adjustment, not a field access -- no instruction reads or writes the four bytes at receiver+0x4.

callees.receiver: the subobject at receiver+0x4, arriving in ECX
callees.return: a 32-bit word in EAX on every path: the decremented subobject word, or zero on the wrap path
callees.evidence: The callee's listing (live Ghidra /disassemble_function at 0x00453540) spills ECX, reads the word at its own receiver+0x4, decrements it, stores the decremented value back, and returns it in EAX; when the decremented value is zero it instead stores 1, invokes slot 0 of the subobject's first word with the argument 1, and returns 0. Its body is not reconstructed in this package; only its entry shape and its EAX width are used.
callees.observed_shape: The target pushes nothing before the call and ends in a bare RET, so the callee takes no ordinary stack argument and pops nothing.

implementation.argument_surface: zero ordinary stack arguments; the receiver arrives in ECX and the callee's receiver is that word plus 0x4
implementation.build_check: clang++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -m32 on the source and the model test, linked as a static library, test binary exits 0.

intended_paths.status: staging-only; no canonical path is claimed and src/ is integrator-owned

evidence.fact: The ten-instruction body is PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x10 / MOV [EBP-0x10],ECX / MOV ECX,[EBP-0x10] / ADD ECX,0x4 / CALL 0x00453540 / MOV ESP,EBP / POP EBP / RET.
The first 24 bytes are 55 8b ec 83 ec 10 89 4d f0 8b 4d f0 83 c1 04 e8 af 81 f3 ff 8b e5 5d c3, followed by CC padding.
The one direct callee is 0x00453540, called from 0x0051e38f.
No jump target is present; the body is straight-line.

The callee is a __thiscall member: it spills ECX, reads the word at its own receiver+0x4, decrements it, stores the decremented value back, and returns it in EAX; on the zero path it stores 1, calls slot 0 of the subobject's first word with argument 1, and returns 0. It ends in a bare RET.
The vptr-backed table at 0x013ef110 holds 0x0051e340 at slot 0 and 0x0051e380 at slot 1; the pair is adjacent in all twelve associated tables.

The target is a slot of a vptr-backed vftable, the callee pops nothing, and no stack word is read as an argument, so it is a non-static virtual member function: receiver in ECX, __thiscall, caller cleans, zero ordinary stack arguments.

corroboration.abi: The V1-VFT rule derives __thiscall with the receiver in ECX and zero ordinary stack arguments from vftable membership plus the bare RET. The listing independently agrees: the only register the body consumes is the incoming ECX, and the only transfer is a direct call with nothing pushed.
corroboration.adjustor: The sibling slot 0x0051e340 applies the same +0x4 adjustment to reach the same subobject before reading the word at subobject+0x4, which corroborates that receiver+0x4 is a subobject base rather than a field offset.
corroboration.return: The sibling slot 0x0051e340 returns the incremented subobject word in EAX on its only exit; the target returns the callee's EAX the same way. The symmetry corroborates the forwarding reading.

unresolved_questions: Is the target's C++ return type the callee's return type (a 32-bit word, declared here) or void with the callee's EAX discarded? The bytes are consistent with both; the forwarding reading is better supported by the sibling symmetry and by the fact that the callee returns a meaningful value, but it is not proven.
Which concrete class owns the vftable, and which concrete type begins at receiver+0x4? Co-membership establishes 'virtual member of some class' and nothing more; SporeApp.exe carries no MSVC RTTI.

What does the subobject word at receiver+0x8 (the callee's receiver+0x4) count? The callee decrements it and wraps to 1 with a virtual notify, which reads as a reference count or a sequence counter, but the listing fixes no name for it.
blockers: The persisted evidence pack for this target holds no disassembly listing, so the machine-derived receiver record, parse record, and dispatch record are all absent. CONTROL FLOW, GLOBALS, CONSTANTS, FIELDS/OFFSETS, and VIRTUAL DISPATCH cannot be adjudicated against a listing and remain NOT_AVAILABLE; this is a capability ceiling of the evidence pack, not of the reconstruction.
notes: The reconstruction states the ABI literally (__thiscall, receiver in ECX, zero ordinary stack arguments) so the ABI dimension can be adjudicated. The one displacement the body states is a this-pointer adjustor, carried as a constexpr pinned to its instruction. The callee is reached through a port so the model test can substitute a stub; the port is a test seam and the machine transfer is a direct call.
